remarks: Stunning direct waterfront Nantucket style home overlooking Sherwood Mill Pond at Westport's Compo Beach. Completely renovated with chic coastal style, this special retreat offers an open floor plan, European-style kitchen, dining area, and multiple living spaces, all with panoramic water views. Upstairs offers 3 stylish bedrooms with generous closets, excellent storage and custom baths. Enjoy sunrise, sunset and the soothing sounds of the water from your private deck. From the seawall, launch a kayak or paddleboard and enjoy time on the water. Peace and tranquility are yours to enjoy and included at no extra charge.
